description: This file defines a PHP class LogarithmicBestFit that extends the BestFit class to implement logarithmic regression analysis, including methods for calculating the best-fit line, obtaining X and Y values for the regression line, and executing the regression process.

classes.name: LogarithmicBestFit
classes.description: A class implementing logarithmic regression, providing methods to compute and analyze the best-fit logarithmic line for data sets.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y-value for a given X-value based on the logarithmic regression model.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X-value corresponding to a given Y-value based on the regression.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns a string representing the equation of the best-fit logarithmic line.

methods.name: logarithmicRegression
methods.description: Performs the logarithmic regression calculation on given Y and X data arrays, adjusting Y-values as necessary.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an instance with data points and performs the regression unless there is an error.
